g.text: Synthetic day of 45 targets with 1–3 visibility windows each (3–10 min), values 1–10, one instrument with 2 min slews, payload energy ≤ 14 units per 96-min
orbit, memory ≤ 40 units between four downlink passes. Exact solution by mixed-integer linear programming (scipy/HiGHS). Flight processors are 100–1 000 times
